description: Experiment D, QUERY load: closed-loop clients send POST /v1/query (sync) with benchmark questions from load-tests/questions-d.txt at 1, 2, 4 and 8 concurrent clients, 120 s per level, at most 60 queries per level, a 60 s pause between levels; after each level one GET /v1/explain per answered or abstained query (per-stage latencies: planner, graph stages, semantic, synthesis, verification). Measures attempted and completed requests, throughput, p50/p95/p99 over all attempts and over answered queries, class counts (answered, abstained, throttled, overloaded, timeout, other), the query, evidence and graph services' desired and running tasks every 15 s, and CloudWatch ALB, ECS, DynamoDB and Neptune series. Runs under the deployed limits (planned deviation 5): API throttle 5 per second burst 10, 4 concurrent queries per query task, 19 LLM requests per minute per task, query/evidence/graph scaling 1 to 2 tasks on 60 % CPU; throttling, overload and timeouts at higher levels are results, and CPU scale-out is not expected.
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml); the Phase 14 graph run:v1:f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4 in Neptune, DynamoDB and S3 Vectors

resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/environments/course (api_throttling_rate_limit 5, api_throttling_burst_limit 10; decision 3); infra/terraform/modules/runtime/autoscaling.tf (query, evidence, graph CPU target tracking, max service_max_count 2); config/course.json (service.maxConcurrentQueries 4, llm.requestsPerMinute 19); hard caps in load-tests/query-load.sh (60 queries per level, at most 8 clients)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. Run in the terminal where SCHOLARCHAIN_SERVICE_API_KEY is exported. COST (estimate): upper bound 240 queries x about $0.0023 = about $0.55 (Phase 10 attempt-06: about 5,500 input and 3,500 output tokens per question at the Haiku rates, 6a); expected about $0.15 to $0.20 because the 19 LLM requests per minute per task and the throttle answer most requests at higher levels without a model call (estimate); explain reads, ALB, Fargate and the metric export add under $0.05; costBoundUsd 1. DURATION: query-load.sh's own deadline about 1,820 s for these arguments (4 x (120 + 35 + 15 + 150 + 60) + 300); maxDurationSeconds 2,400. METRICS: AWS/ApplicationELB TargetResponseTime, RequestCount, HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count and HTTPCode_Target_4XX_Count with LoadBalancer and TargetGroup seen in account; HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count docs only (cited: not listed because the ALB has returned no 5xx in the retention window; the same metric and dimension are used by the alb-5xx alarm, infra/terraform/modules/observability/alarms.tf, and the ALB metrics page https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-cloudwatch-metrics.html, not re-read in 6b); the {alb-dimension} and {alb-target-group-ROLE} placeholders resolve from the Phase 15 outputs alb_arn_suffix and target_group_arn_suffixes, which exist only after D4; AWS/ECS CPUUtilization, MemoryUtilization and LiveTaskCount seen in account for the three services; DynamoDB ConsumedRead/WriteCapacityUnits and SuccessfulRequestLatency (TableName, Operation) seen in account; DynamoDB ThrottledRequests and ReadThrottleEvents docs only (cited: published only when a request is throttled, so not listed; DynamoDB metrics page https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/metrics-dimensions.html, not re-read in 6b); an empty throttle series is reported as 'no throttle datapoint', not as 0; AWS/Neptune CPUUtilization, OpenCypherRequestsPerSec, TotalRequestsPerSec, MainRequestQueuePendingRequests and TotalServerErrorsPerSec seen in account (the DBClusterIdentifier is the cluster name from list-metrics, not a host); AWS/ApiGateway dropped (its ApiId dimension is the first label of the API host and the runner has no placeholder for it). Neptune latency separate from the graph stages, vector-query latency separate from Voyage, and HTTP retries per query are missing from explain (6a). LIMITATIONS known in advance: no limit is raised for D; the levels are 1, 2, 4, 8 (deviation 5); CloudWatch periods that span a level boundary are marked boundary.
